samples.summary: Slides mobile toolbar keeps the buggy caret-based B/I/U toggle, and now disagrees with the fixed TextFormatGroup inside the same bar
samples.evidence: `TextEditMobileBar` still does `textEditor.applyStyle({ bold: !textEditor.getSelectionStyle().bold })` (lines 225, 228, 231-233) and `pressed={!!sel.bold}` from `textEditor.getSelectionStyle()` (line 223/240). The slides `SlidesTextBoxEditor.getSelectionStyle()` delegates to the docs text-box editor, whose caret walk uses the same `cursor.position.offset <= inlineEnd` resolution described in issue #715, so a backward selection inside a slides text box still inverts the wrong value (bold can be removed but never re-applied). Worse, the *same component* renders `TextFormatGroup` in its overflow sheet at line 552, which is now range-aware — so the two Bold buttons on one screen behave differently for the same selection. The task doc (docs/tasks/active/20260810-docs-range-aware-toggles-todo.md:60) declares this out of scope, but `getRangeStyleSummary()` is already on `SlidesTextBoxEditor` (packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:601), so the same one-line fix applies.

samples.summary: Header/footer slim toolbar B/I/U Toggles have no `pressed` prop, so their visual state is uncontrolled and unrelated to the document
samples.evidence: Lines 449, 458, 467 render `<Toggle size="sm" onPressedChange={toggleBold} ...>` with no `pressed` binding. Radix `Toggle` then keeps its own internal pressed state, which flips on every click regardless of what the document actually holds. The change routes the slim toolbar's *action* through `getRangeStyleSummary()` (the todo's task item says 'route ... their pressed state' too), but the displayed state is still arbitrary: e.g. on a 'mixed' range one click applies bold and the button shows pressed, then selecting an unbolded range still shows pressed. Pre-existing, but it is the same defect class the diff set out to fix and the slim toolbar was explicitly in scope.

samples.summary: `getRangeStyleSummary()` is now called on every render, turning an O(1) caret read into an O(selected inlines) walk on each toolbar re-render
samples.evidence: Line 96 `const styleSummary = editor?.getRangeStyleSummary();` runs during render. In the docs editor (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2773-2963) the non-collapsed branch walks every block and every inline in the selection, JSON-stringifying object values via `tokenize`. The toolbar re-renders on every cursor-move / selection change (drag-select), so dragging a selection over a large document now performs a full inline walk per pointer move, where the previous `getSelectionStyle()` was a single-block lookup. Not a behavioural bug, but a plausible interactive-latency regression on big selections (e.g. Ctrl+A in a long doc).

samples.summary: Cmd/Ctrl+B keyboard path still uses the caret-based decision, so issue #715 remains reproducible via the shortcut
samples.evidence: The todo (docs/tasks/active/20260810-docs-range-aware-toggles-todo.md:52-56) records that `TextEditor.toggleStyle` reads `getStyleAtCursor()` and is left unfixed. Users hitting Cmd+B on a backward selection therefore still get the inverted toggle the issue describes, and the toolbar button and the keyboard shortcut now behave differently for the identical selection. Flagging as a known-but-live correctness gap rather than a defect in the diff.

finding.evidence: `TextEditMobileBar` still does `textEditor.applyStyle({ bold: !textEditor.getSelectionStyle().bold })` (lines 225, 228, 231-233) and `pressed={!!sel.bold}` from `textEditor.getSelectionStyle()` (line 223/240). verdict.reason: All claims verify against the repository. TextEditMobileBar reads caret style via `const sel = textEditor.getSelectionStyle()` (mobile-toolbar.tsx:223) and inverts it for B/I/U at lines 225, 228, 231-233, with pressed state from `!!sel.bold/italic/underline` at 240/245/253 — exactly as claimed. That call delegates straight through: SlidesTextBoxEditor.getSelectionStyle() returns api.getSelectionStyle() (packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:598-600), reaching the docs caret walk at packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1006-1012 whose `cursor.position.offset <= inlineEnd` condition matches at a run boundary and returns the PRECEDING run's style. For a backward selection the caret sits at the range start, so the toggle inverts the wrong value (bold removable but never re-applicable) — the issue #715 pattern. The same-component inconsistency is also real: TextFormatGroup is rendered at mobile-toolbar.tsx:552 within TextFormatSheet in the same file, and it is range-aware via getRangeStyleSummary() + isStyleOn() for both pressed state (text-format-group.tsx:163,181,199) and inversion (100,106,113); its comment at text-format-group.tsx:91-96 explicitly names the backward-selection/issue-#715 bug it avoids. So a fixed and an unfixed Bold button coexist on one screen for the same selection. The proposed fix is available since getRangeStyleSummary() exists on SlidesTextBoxEditor (interface 240-251, impl 601-603). The path is reachable: MobileSlidesToolbar dispatches state.kind === "text-edit" to TextEditMobileBar (mobile-toolbar.tsx:94), rendered from toolbar/index.tsx:88. This is in the correctness lane (wrong condition / inverted logic yielding incorrect state), and a task-doc "out of scope" note is not a guard that makes the path unreachable. No refutation ground applies.
